summary: Three defects reported from a screenshot of the Sheet, all three real, none of them visible in any test that existed. FIRST, the close control used griddy's `X`, which is the X/Twitter wordmark rather than a cross — and its path hard-codes fill="black" instead of currentColor, so it rendered black-on-charcoal in dark beside a correctly-lit back arrow. 73 of griddy's ~1160 glyphs do this; they are the brand marks. `lint-licensing` now resolves every icon imported by distributed source and rejects any whose fill is fixed, which is both a rendering rule and a trademark one — shipping someone's logo inside a UI kit is the class of question this gate exists for. `Close` is the cross glyph, and both story imports were wrong. SECOND, no component except Badge ever sized its icon slot, so every glyph rendered at griddy's IconBase default of 24px regardless of the component or its size prop: measured 24px in an lg, md and sm Button alike, where the sheet draws 16 at all four sizes, and at sm a 24px glyph exactly filled the 24px button. Button, Input, Banner and Sidebar now size the slot at 16, and a new cross-component test — registry/ui/icon-slot.browser.test.tsx, deliberately outside any one component's folder because the rule is the system's — asserts it for ten cases, asserts Badge keeps its own smaller 12px at sm rather than being flattened by a well-meant sweep, and asserts a consumer can still override. Probed by removing Button's class and watching five cases fail with the actual pixel width in the message. THIRD, a portalled panel leaves the themed subtree: theme tokens are inherited custom properties and document.body is not inside a brand scope, so the drawer painted theme zero inside a branded portal. Sheet, Modal and Popover take a `container` prop, and the browser suite pins BOTH halves — without it the panel is outside the scope and paints white; with it, it inherits the brand's own --ui-bg-base. It is a prop rather than an automatic resolution because the container becomes the panel's containing block, and an ancestor with a transform or overflow:hidden would clip a full-height fixed drawer; only the caller knows whether theirs is safe. Multiselect's panel still has no equivalent.

migration.manual: Icons inside Button, Input, Banner and Sidebar now render at 16px instead of 24. A layout that compensated for the oversize glyph with its own spacing will shift. Override per call site with className="[&_svg]:size-6" if a larger glyph was intended. griddy's brand-mark icons (any with a hard-coded fill) are now a build error in distributed source.
